notes.title: New update
notes.content:
-Fixes some bugs such as a crash on graphical setting change and the inability of getting to the pool table
-Update to the newest 3.5.2 Godot engine
-Added FXAA support for a faster if a bit blurrier anti alias solution
-Improvement on the shadow quality and performance
-Small details

notes.title: Further mouse fixes
notes.content: Fixed some further mouse issues related to high poll rate devices and a small typo.

notes.title: Fixing input issues with some video setups.
notes.content:
Fixed the input issues caused by uncapped or high frame rate conditions in some setups that were causing unstable or frozen mouse inputs.

Mouse capture event when entering a level has been tweaked to avoid causing confusion on new players's user experience.
